steps.label: VERSION 1
captions: Two plates on a hinge that should click at five angles.
Our first print: no click at all, and the pin fell out.

steps.label: VERSION 2
captions: A ratchet, with buttons to release it. Still no click.
Its teeth were 0.45 mm deep. Printing errors can add up to 0.75 mm.

steps.label: VERSION 3
captions: So we started from the numbers: an easel, its angles set by deep notches.
Our test print: good, but it needs to be 3 pieces that stay together.

steps.label: VERSION 4
captions: The prop is hinged inside the plate, and the plate is pinned to the base.
Six angles, from 80 down to 55 degrees...
...and it folds flat to 34 mm, with nothing to lose.

steps.label: TESTED FIRST
captions: We printed just the two hinges first. Our verdict: it works well.
Next: the whole stand goes on the printer.
